svg.title: Diffusion Model Flowchart
svg.desc: Diffusion Model: Training phase adds noise step by step to images. Generation phase reverses the process guided by a text prompt to produce a new image.
svg.text: Training phase — "Teaching the model what noise looks like"
The ANN learns: "At each step, exactly how much noise was added?"
Generation phase — "Creating new content from noise"

g.text: "A golden retriever on a beach at sunset"

svg.text: The ANN uses the text prompt at EVERY denoising step to guide what image is being formed
That is why "a golden retriever" and "a cat" from the same noise produce completely different images
